sloka: तान् सर्वान् धनुर् आदाय समाश्वास्य च दूषणः ।अभ्यधावत सुसंक्रुद्धः क्रुद्धः [रुद्रम्] क्रुद्ध इव अन्तकः ॥३-२५-३१॥
transliteration: tān sarvān dhanur ādāya samāśvāsya ca dūṣaṇaḥ ।abhyadhāvata susaṁkruddhaḥ kruddhaḥ [rudram] kruddha iva antakaḥ ॥3-25-31॥

translations.english: Under Dusana's protection, all of them felt relieved from fear and, carrying sal and palm trees and stones as weapons, advanced towards Rama again.
